items.title: Lamarck ka nazariya aur zarafa (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Lamarck's mechanism and the giraffe example, printed pages 223-224.

blocks.text: 1- Aaza (organs) ka istemal aur adam-istemal (use and disuse)

Lamarck ka khayal tha ke jab kisi jandar ke mahol mein tabdeeli aati hai to woh jism ke kuch hisson ya aaza (organs) ko zyada istemal karne lagta hai aur kuch ko istemal karna chhor deta hai. Un ke mutabiq jo aaza zyada istemal hote hain woh taraqqi kar ke mazboot ho jate hain, aur jo theek se istemal nahin hote woh kharab ya kamzor ho jate hain. Lambe arse tak istemal ya adam-istemal se jism ke hisson mein aane wali in tabdeeliyon ko unhon ne “acquired characters” (zindagi mein hasil ki hui khasiyatein) ka naam diya.

Lamarck samajhte the ke jandar apni zindagi mein jo khasiyatein hasil karta hai woh us ke bachchon mein muntaqil ho jati hain. Jab yeh acquired characters nasl dar nasl aage jate hain to aakhir kaar jandar mein aisi tabdeeliyan (modifications) aa jati hain jin se woh mahol ki tabdeeliyon ka behtar muqabla (“cope”) kar sake.
